title: Ending epilogue line 'Old Crick still isn't buying whatever an Envoy tried to sell him' doesn't match the actual scene: the Envoy option there ('turn on the charm (a gamble)') succeeded, and Crick unprompted paid 2 gold for the nostalgia — no sale was ever attempted or refused.
where: ending epilogue (Old Crick) / earlier: The Miners' Hall, Cinderhall, talk to Old Crick

evidence.quote: Ending epilogue line 'Old Crick still isn't buying whatever an Envoy tried to sell him' doesn't match the actual scene: the Envoy option there ('turn on the charm (a gamble)') succeeded, and Crick unprompted paid 2 gold for the nostalgia — no sale was ever attempted or refused.
